6.1.value: KKR Private Equity Conglomerate LLC ('K-PEC'), Delaware limited liability company formed December 6, 2022; governed by Sixth Amended and Restated LLC Agreement dated December 4, 2024; operates so it is NOT an 'investment company' under the Investment Company Act (no exemptive order — the word 'exemptive' has zero hits) and so it qualifies as a partnership for U.S. federal income tax purposes. Holding company owning portfolio companies through Joint Ventures formed by pooling capital with KKR Vehicles, with Company and KKR Vehicle as co-general partners of each JV; interests held via wholly owned 'Operating Subsidiaries' — K-PEC Holdings LLC (and similar holdcos) — which in turn hold JV interests through corporations/LLCs/LPs (e.g., aggregators such as KKR Modena Aggregator L.P., KKR Precise Aggregator L.P., KKR Compass Aggregator L.P.). Other named subsidiaries: K-PEC HedgeCo LLC (Line of Credit borrower; borrower role assigned to K-PEC Asset Funding LLC on 12/30/2025), K-PEC Liquidity Limited (revolver borrower representative). ASC 946 basis of consolidation: only certain wholly owned subsidiaries consolidated; portfolio companies NOT consolidated. Twelve share classes: Investor Shares S, D, U, I, R-S, R-D, R-U, R-I (R-classes closed to purchase after the 18-month Initial Offering; Investor Share R-classes no longer purchasable as of January 2, 2025) plus KKR Shares E, F, G, H; KKR (Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co. L.P.) holds all Class G Shares with special governance rights; KKR Group Assets Holdings III L.P. (wholly owned subsidiary of KKR & Co. Inc.) is the Class G beneficial owner.

6.2.value: Strategy: private equity conglomerate — acquire, own and control portfolio companies via Joint Ventures with KKR Vehicles (Company typically GP/co-GP; majority of JVs majority-own or primarily control portfolio companies); six business lines: Business & Financial Services; Consumer & Retail; Healthcare; Impact; Industrials; Technology, Media & Telecommunications. Allocation targets as printed: ~80% of assets in portfolio companies; up to 20% of total assets in the 'Liquidity Portfolio' (cash, cash equivalents, liquid investment-grade credit, KKR-managed funds/securities; may exceed 20% at times). Portfolio construction guidelines: no cryptocurrency; no more than 5% of assets in 'blind pools'; no more than 10% in publicly traded equity securities (with carve-outs). Instruments: foreign currency forward contracts to hedge FX on non-USD holdings (FY2025: realized loss $64,346 thousand; unrealized appreciation $27,607 / depreciation $5,177 at 12/31/2025); may enter derivatives, swaps or other financial products to hedge interest rate risk; JV/aggregator LP interests; money market funds. Also alongside KKR's Core Investment Platform for 'core' PE (lower-return, longer-hold investments).
